purpose: Advisory identity and acting locks for the persistent Grok Builder handoff. This file is not an executable shot card and does not grant generation or delivery approval.

authority.source_rule: Stable entity IDs and bound reference IDs control identity. Historical boards, runtime captures, old pinned/standing Eagle art, and attractive generated panels are not appearance authority.

global_direction.medium: Complete polished 2D storybook frame; motion references remain editorial only.
global_direction.camera: Use the shot's locked camera unless a reviewed card explicitly states one camera move. Preserve room geometry and character relationships; do not use camera drift or reframing to hide identity or contact failures.
continuity: A complete first frame must be reviewed before motion generation.
Keep identity, topology, object ownership, handedness, and contacts continuous across every frame.
No HUD, text, runtime capture pixels, added fixtures, identity drift, anatomy drift, or invented room architecture.
Use only the two to four references explicitly bound by a reviewed shot card; a database reference pool is not an instruction to bind every image.
Scale is qualitative and relational. Do not invent numeric proportions; establish relative scale in the complete first frame against the bound room and cast.
When a view or action is not established by the source, leave it unresolved for human review rather than inventing anatomy or a turnaround.

voice_policy.allowed: Existing project recordings only, within their existing approved scope.
forbidden: New synthetic character dialogue presented as family voice
Using a generated voice to fill a missing line or approval gap
voice_policy.default: Use no character voice when no existing recording is bound; a gentle contact foley/room-tone line is acceptable in the shot card.

characters.name: Roshan
identity_locks: Young mermaid child with the approved brown hair and rainbow hair accents.
Tiara, pink bodice, child-readable face, and one continuous rainbow tail with its authored fluke.
Curious, brave, affectionate presence; child scale relative to Daddy, Rumi, rooms, and props.
anatomy_and_continuity: No legs, adult redesign, extra tail, duplicate torso, or disconnected tail/fluke.
Hands and arms must remain attached and readable through reaches, hugs, and tool contacts.
Do not change the approved hair, tiara, bodice, tail identity, or face between frames.
forbidden_changes: Legs, fins replacing the continuous tail, extra limbs, or mirrored identity drift
Unapproved costume, hair, tiara, or tail redesign
acting_and_movement: Use small, readable child actions: settle, look, reach, scrub, lift, pull, and gentle recovery gestures.
Contact must precede the visible cleanup result; preserve the commissioned Day One order: bath, pool, Eagle rescue, craft room, then team work.
Affectionate proximity is allowed with Daddy and Rumi; do not turn a task beat into an uncommissioned performance or pose.
characters.object_contact_and_handedness: Roshan is the primary Day One worker. The source does not establish one permanent dominant brush hand. Choose a hand in the reviewed complete first frame, show an unambiguous grip/contact, and keep that hand, tool orientation, and body support continuous; never mirror or swap hands mid-shot. No tool may move by itself.
characters.scale_authority: Use the bound Roshan identity plus the reviewed complete first frame and current room reference. Preserve child scale relationally; do not add numeric proportions.

established: Daughter/child relationship with Daddy; Daddy offers a hand and reassuring proximity.
Roshan meets Rumi after the pool is restored and Rumi emerges.
Roshan frees Baby Eagle after the Rumi event and later works with the four-helper group.
unknown_or_pending: Exact new pose, hand choice, and complete ensemble staging remain shot-specific first-frame decisions.
No unreviewed alternate Roshan view becomes a new identity authority.

characters.camera_view_limits: The 256x256 full-body identity is an appearance/layout authority, not a complete pose library. Keep face, hair, tiara, bodice, tail continuity, and child scale stable in any approved view; do not infer a new costume or anatomy from historical panels.
characters.first_frame_approval: Missing for every current Roshan-bearing shot. Current cards have no human-approved complete IMAGE_1.

characters.name: Daddy Mermaid
characters.portrait_only_scope: Chapter 2 party portrait source only; never substitute it for the cinematic Daddy master.
identity_locks: Clean-shaven slender face, long straight brown hair, pointed ears, thin rectangular black glasses, and jeweled crown.
High-neck long-sleeve navy coat with gold embroidery and teal cape with shell clasps.
One continuous rainbow tail with multicolor fluke; patient fatherly presence.
anatomy_and_continuity: Keep the slender face, glasses, ears, hair silhouette, coat/cape, tail, and fluke connected and stable.
Hands must remain readable when offering a hand, holding position, or taking a team-cleaning contact.
Relative adult scale is established only against the reviewed shot first frame and the room; no numeric ratio is authoritative.
forbidden_changes: Beard, curly hair, generic king costume, solid-blue tail, extra tail, or adult identity drift
Replacing the master with the Chapter 2 portrait, a historical board, or a runtime capture
Invented royal props, changed crown, or costume embellishment not present in the master
acting_and_movement: Offer a hand and maintain reassuring proximity during arrival or family beats.
For revised bunny/team actions, use calm coordinated helper movements with visible contacts, never frantic or heroic posing.
Do not make Daddy perform an action assigned to Roshan, Rumi, Eagle, or the rainbow friend unless the shot card explicitly assigns it.
characters.object_contact_and_handedness: No fixed canonical Daddy brush hand is approved. Establish the hand and grip in the complete first frame: fingers wrap the handle behind the bristle head, bristles point toward and contact the bunny, never backwards through Daddy's hands. Preserve grip and tool orientation through contact/release; no mirrored hand swap. Do not invent brush action in arrival or identity-only beats.
characters.scale_authority: The Daddy master controls appearance; use reviewed first-frame staging for relative adult/child scale. Do not promote the Chapter 2 portrait's crop or any numeric ratio to cinematic authority.

established: Daddy is Roshan's patient father and offers reassuring proximity.
Daddy is one of the four helpers in the revised bunny scrub/reveal and clean-hall team jobs.
unknown_or_pending: Exact hand assignment, contact side, and ensemble pose remain pending per-shot first-frame approval.
No approved Daddy turnaround or alternate performance view is registered beyond the master.

characters.camera_view_limits: The master is the identity authority, not an approval of every side/back/foreshortened view. Keep the glasses, hair, ears, crown, coat, cape, tail, and fluke legible; do not use the portrait-only reference for cinematic appearance.
characters.first_frame_approval: Missing for every current Daddy-bearing shot.

characters.name: Rumi
identity_locks: Adult mermaid with an enormous sculpted violet braid and pointed ears.
Star-shell earrings and navy/lavender jacket with the authored trim.
Aqua/violet/pink tail with coral split fin; preserve the adult silhouette and color identity.
anatomy_and_continuity: Keep both arms, torso, braid, tail, and split fin distinct and attached.
During hugs or group work, separate Rumi's arms/tail from Roshan, Daddy, Eagle, and props; do not fuse limbs or tails.
Use adult scale relationally from the reviewed ensemble first frame, not invented numeric proportions.
forbidden_changes: Child redesign, shortened or generic hair, missing braid, missing pointed ears, or changed earrings
Single undifferentiated tail, fused arms/torsos, wrong fin colors, or extra limbs
Unapproved costume, weapon, crown, or new mermaid species traits
acting_and_movement: Rumi emerges and greets Roshan only after the pool restoration sequence.
In revised bunny/team jobs, use coordinated, readable helper actions and gentle settling; preserve independent body contacts.
Do not imply Rumi was present before the commissioned rescue/meeting event unless the shot's before-state says so.
characters.object_contact_and_handedness: No fixed canonical Rumi brush hand is approved. If a team shot assigns a tool, bind the hand and contact in the reviewed complete first frame and keep grip, arm path, and release continuous; never mirror hands or let the tool float. Rumi's emergence/greeting does not require an invented cleaning prop.
characters.scale_authority: The full-body Rumi identity controls appearance. Relative adult scale and hug spacing must be solved in the complete first frame; no numeric scale is invented from the portrait crop.

established: Rumi is rescued after the purple seahorse is unblocked and emerges to greet Roshan.
Rumi later participates as one of the four helpers with Roshan, Daddy, and Baby Eagle.
unknown_or_pending: Exact greeting pose, hug contact, hand assignment, and group spacing remain shot-specific and unapproved.
No approved alternate back/side action view is registered.

characters.camera_view_limits: The single full-body source is identity/layout authority only. Do not infer unseen braid, tail, hand, or fin geometry from historical panels; keep any new view pending human first-frame review.
characters.first_frame_approval: Missing for every current Rumi-bearing shot.

characters.name: Baby Eagle
identity_locks: Original-book body and neck proportions; soft turquoise/mint scalloped feathers with pastel transitions.
Yellow eye patch, pink three-lobed crest, glossy blue eyes with authored lashes.
Lavender beak base with black hooked tip; pink wings with broad black outer tips; soft silver-grey legs with rounded plush toes.
anatomy_and_continuity: The original book crop is partly occluded by the backpack. Unobscured anatomy, back/underside, and flight/wingbeat turnaround are not approved.
Preserve exactly two wings and the visible authored feather/leg/toe silhouette; do not sharpen toes into black talons.
Keep the book identity stable when removing pins, freeing the bird, and showing the one recovery wingbeat.
forbidden_changes: Standing/pinned redesigns, squat mascot proportions, saturated armor-like scales, backpack added to the film, or invented anatomy
All-black oversized beak, extra wings, extra legs, sharpened talons, changed crest/eye patch, or generic bird substitution
A flight turnaround or wing choreography inferred from an unseen side/back view
acting_and_movement: Begin trapped in the fully dressed Stuffie Room; remove two pins before the bird is free.
After release, use one readable recovery wingbeat and settle; do not add a separate flight sequence.
Eagle is a helper in the revised group beats only after the commissioned rescue state; preserve the room dressing.
characters.object_contact_and_handedness: Baby Eagle has no approved brush-hand or tool-contact role. Do not assign a brush, articulated paws, or a new prop. Pin removal must be established by the reviewed complete first frame and must not require invented Eagle anatomy.
characters.scale_authority: Use the original-book Eagle crop and the reviewed dressed Stuffie Room first frame for qualitative relative scale. No numeric proportion or unobscured anatomy may be invented.

established: Roshan frees Eagle after the Rumi event in the dressed Stuffie Room.
Eagle joins Daddy, Rumi, and Roshan as a helper only in the revised bunny/team sequence after rescue.
unknown_or_pending: Exact pin placement, free pose, and wingbeat view require a human-approved complete first frame.
Unobscured body/back/underside and a flight turnaround remain unavailable.

characters.camera_view_limits: Keep the source-facing book crop and room dressing as the safe identity boundary. No new back, underside, or extended-flight view is accepted until separately reviewed; historical Eagle panels cannot fill that gap.
characters.first_frame_approval: Missing for SHOT-EAGLE-FREE, SHOT-EAGLE-WING, and every later ensemble shot containing Eagle.

locks: Grand Puff begins as an intact big lavender bunny with his own spiral ears, crest, face, and pearl details.
Only coordinated group scrubbing causes bubbles to hide the silhouette; the casing collapses as the little friend jumps.
Friendly transformation only: no pain, corpse, shards, explosion, or extra intact giant after the collapse.
grand_puff.conflict_note: The revised continuous soap/emerge/collapse sequence supersedes earless-mound, early-rainbow-ear, hard-cut, and intact-shell alternatives.

locks: Two broad spiral ears: left coral/yellow, right mint/blue/lavender.
Pink forehead curl with four-point prismatic sparkle, layered cloud scallops, plum glossy eyes, pink cheeks, and authored dark-plum outline.
No wings, legs, teeth, crown, extra bunny, or invented articulated paws; remain completely hidden until the jump.
rainbow_friend.conflict_note: This is a concept identity reference, not an owner-approved complete first frame. It does not approve early ears, an early reveal, or a second friend.

ordinary_playroom_bunny.note: Distinct ordinary playroom species; never substitute it for Baby Eagle, Grand Puff, or the Rainbow Dust Bunny.

current_job_coverage.shared_shot_rule: Every listed shot remains draft/replacement with a missing human-approved complete first frame and no delivery acceptance.

example_action_direction_fragments.note: Examples only; convert into a reviewed per-shot card with exact IMAGE_1–IMAGE_4 bindings before any generation request.
fragments: Roshan: locked camera; establish the approved child mermaid and tool in one complete frame; one hand keeps the brush in visible contact while the clean patch appears; no hand swap or fixture drift.

Daddy/Rumi/Eagle team: start with the approved ensemble first frame and separate limbs/tails; each helper performs only the named contact; maintain Daddy's master identity, Rumi's braid and fin, and Eagle's book identity.
Eagle: begin in the dressed Stuffie Room with both pins visible; remove the pins, then show one recovery wingbeat; do not reveal an invented back/underside or add a backpack.
Grand Puff/Rainbow: keep Grand Puff intact until wet foam fully obscures him; Rainbow remains hidden until the jump and simultaneous casing collapse; no early ears or surviving intact shell.
